answer: Charge one noncopyable admission credit per new identity. A credit is minted only after 30 separately paid and independently verified jobs, such as opal appraisal, echo analysis or transcription of a quill manuscript. Admission burns the credit; new accounts start with none. Splitting a wallet cannot increase the credit supply. Creating k aliases therefore consumes k credits obtained by doing 30k verified jobs or buying that scarce work from others, rather than merely generating keys.
